story: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT Chat and Work into one shared usage limit, and new Business sign-ups by Nov 30 get 2x usage and fast mode
source_line: Sources: OpenAI ChatGPT pricing page, TechCrunch, TechCity

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Double ChatGPT Business usage, free
segments.narration: New ChatGPT Business sign-ups by November thirtieth get double usage, plus fast mode.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Chat and Work share one limit
segments.narration: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT Chat and Work into one shared usage limit, rolling out wider in December.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Instant chats stay unlimited
segments.narration: Instant model conversations stay unlimited and don't count toward the shared allowance.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: The catch: heavy users
segments.narration: Most users aren't expected to wait for resets more often, but heavy users may hit limits sooner.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Sign up early, watch usage
segments.narration: Our take: if you're considering Business, sign up before November thirtieth and track heavy users.
